title: Motivation Is Overrated; Environment Often Matters More
coreMove: Redesign the physical space around a behavior so the desired action is the path of least resistance and the unwanted action requires friction to reach.

exampleSpecs.domain: a night-shift ICU nurse trying to drink more water across a twelve-hour shift
exampleSpecs.audience: a healthcare worker whose schedule fights every standard habit advice
exampleSpecs.stakes: chronic dehydration headaches that compound over a three-on-three-off rotation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the nurse stops trying to remember and instead moves a labeled water bottle onto the charting cart she touches every forty minutes; the cue does the remembering for her

exampleSpecs.domain: a freelance illustrator whose phone sits face-up on the drafting table
exampleSpecs.audience: a creative working from a one-room apartment with no separate studio
exampleSpecs.stakes: a deadline she keeps missing by ninety minutes a day in scattered phone pickups
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the contrast shows the same person, same willpower, same morning — only the phone has moved to a drawer in the kitchen, and the output doubles without a single new technique

exampleSpecs.domain: a regional grocery chain redesigning the checkout lane to reduce candy purchases by parents with children
exampleSpecs.audience: a store operations manager balancing margin against complaints
exampleSpecs.stakes: a small revenue dip against a measurable drop in customer-reported guilt and post-shop returns
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the manager realizes the candy was never being chosen — it was being grabbed because it was at hand-height in a five-minute wait, and removing it didn't change anyone's preferences, only their reach

exampleSpecs.domain: a recovering insomniac who keeps the bedroom for sleep and sex only and reads in the kitchen
exampleSpecs.audience: a graduate student in a studio apartment where every surface serves five purposes
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether sleep onset improves enough to keep her qualifying-exam prep on track
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she chooses to carry the laptop out of the bedroom rather than promise herself she'll stop using it in bed; the rule is enforced by geography, not discipline

exampleSpecs.domain: a high school orchestra teacher leaving her violin assembled on a stand in the living room
exampleSpecs.audience: a working musician-parent who has not practiced in eleven months
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether she ever performs again, or quietly stops calling herself a player
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the violin out of the case is the entire intervention — the chapter shows her picking it up on a Tuesday for four minutes while waiting for pasta water, and that being enough to count

exampleSpecs.domain: a couple trying to argue less by changing where the argument happens
exampleSpecs.audience: two partners six years in, neither of whom is leaving
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the relationship's conflict pattern hardens or softens over the next year
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they discover that moving hard conversations from the bedroom to a walk around the block changes the conversation itself, because the room was carrying old residue the words couldn't escape
